name: Pipeline SAST

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  semgrep:
    name: Analise de Seguranca
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout do codigo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build da aplicacao (Validacao)
        run: |
          cd app
          docker build -t app-teste .

      - name: Executar Semgrep
        uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: "p/default"
